## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run build`, `npm run check` and `npm test` pass.
- [ ] New behavior and the bug a fix closes have tests.
- [ ] No keys, tokens, `.env` files, run logs, HAR files or screenshots of real accounts are included.
- [ ] Docs and `CHANGELOG.md` (Unreleased) are updated if users see the change.
- [ ] If this changes planning, move choice, typing or what counts as risky: say so, so a maintainer runs the evals.
- [ ] If this weakens a safety default (approvals, risky actions, credentials, limits): the reason is explained above.
